description.translate: You kept your word. I took his ring into an Ancient City, hoping its inscriptions would help me finish our work. A Warden cornered me. The protective ward saved my life, but I lost the ring escaping. Its flight remained sealed; it could not carry me out. By the time I returned, The Ranker had already gone to face the Inferno. The ring's greater power still needs awakening and a bond to its bearer. Seek Sister Ysra Vale. Ask her what it means to give something freely when the cost is real.
